Subject: Invoice submission and PO mapping ahead of go-live

Hi Ben,

Thanks again — we're moving to final steps for our activation next week and wanted to confirm the invoice delivery path and PO mapping expectations. A few specifics from our side: 
- Will Redwood accept invoices via email (billing@redwood.com) as a fallback, or do you require portal uploads only?
- We often have multiple PO numbers on a single shipment (split-PO). Can you confirm whether you require separate invoices per PO or a single invoice with PO line items?
- Attached a sample PDF and CSV with two example invoices (lumenmade_sample_invoice_202806.pdf, invoice_sample_rows.csv).

We prefer to start with an email fallback while we test portal connectivity. Any constraints on subject line tokens or required headers?

Thanks,
Asha Rao
Head of Finance, LumenMade
attachments: lumenmade_sample_invoice_202806.pdf, invoice_sample_rows.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Invoice submission and PO mapping ahead of go-live

Hi Asha — great to hear we're close. Quick answers and next steps: 

1) Channel: Portal is our preferred long-term path (better tracking, retries, idempotency). For go-live we will accept email as a documented fallback for 30 days while you finalize portal SSO. Email fallback will need: 
   - To: billing@redwood.com
   - Subject: INVOICE LumenMade <vendor_id_254> <invoice_number> (example: INVOICE LM-202806-09)
   - PDF or CSV attachment is fine. CSV column mapping must match the header we provide (see below).

2) Multiple POs on one invoice: We can accept multiple PO numbers in one invoice if each PO is represented as a separate line item (preferred). If you prefer one invoice per PO, that's also acceptable but increases processing overhead. Our recommendation: single invoice, multiple PO line items.

3) Required fields (CSV header suggestion): invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), total_amount, po_number, line_description, qty, unit_price, tax_amount, supplier_tax_id.

Monica — can you pick this up and send the formal onboarding form (vendor_onboard_form.pdf) + the subject-token example we want? Karthik — please confirm whether any extra metadata is required for multi-entity remits.

Ben
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@lumenmade.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission and PO mapping ahead of go-live

Hi Asha — attaching the vendor onboarding form (vendor_onboard_form.pdf). A few operational notes pulled from our AP playbook: 

- Email fallback window: 30 days from activation; after that we expect portal ingestion for automated matching.
- Subject token: exactly "INVOICE LM-<vendor_id>-<invoice_number>"; vendor_id for LumenMade is 254. If token is missing we'll route to manual queue which delays payment.
- PDF attachments: single PDF per invoice work best. If you must bundle multiple invoices in one PDF, include a cover CSV for line extraction.
- CSV encoding: UTF-8; commas as delimiters; no BOM.

On PO stamping: we recommend including PO numbers on every line; for split-POs, include a separate row per PO. Example provided in invoice_sample_rows.csv. If you cannot break out rows, we will accept a delimited po_numbers column but that will require manual parsing and may delay processing.

I'll also add a small checklist to the onboarding form for your integrations team. Can you confirm whether you'll use the portal SFTP or API for direct CSV pushes?

Monica
AP Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: vendor_onboard_form.pdf
From: Asha Rao <asha@lumenmade.com>

Monica — thanks, the form looks good. Quick clarifications: 

- We'll use the portal API (JSON/CSV) for daily pushes once SSO is confirmed. For the initial three days after activation we'll send email fallback while the portal certs are validated.
- We can include vendor_id 254 in the subject as requested.
- Regarding split-POs: our ERP typically produces one invoice with multiple po_numbers in separate line rows; we'll make sure to send separate rows per PO.

Attaching a small sample CSV export that matches your header proposal (invoice_sample_rows.csv). Please confirm acceptance so we can schedule a final test on Tuesday.

Thanks,
Asha

Thanks Asha — all set from our side. Recap and action items: 

- Redwood accepts: portal API (preferred) and email fallback for the first 3 business days. After 30 days we'll require portal-only.
- Subject token: "INVOICE LM-254-<invoice_number>" — required for email fallback.
- CSV header accepted: invoice_number, invoice_date, total_amount, po_number, line_description, qty, unit_price, tax_amount, supplier_tax_id.
- Split-PO handling: OK as separate rows. If you ever need to send multiple POs in a single CSV cell, mark them as semicolon-separated and include a sample in support ticket.

Next steps: Asha to send test CSV to staging endpoint on Tuesday. Monica to confirm SFTP/API onboarding window and provide HubSpot checklist link (hubspot deal HS-99823). Karthik to confirm multi-entity remit handling if it comes up.

Ben
